newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes stable in thin talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes stable in thin talks.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Wednesday but talks were thin despite crude gains as Japan's golden week holiday decreased enquiries, traders said.
"The market is quiet ahead of the May Day holiday," said one trader. "Not much is going on due to the holiday mood."
Bunker 380-cst and 180-cst supplies were quoted around their Tuesday levels at $97/$98 and $102/$103 per tonne.
MDO and gas oil were at around $195 and $210 respectively.
